architecture.platform: DJI Mavic Mini with Raspberry Pi companion and fixed ground station
architecture.control_boundary: Mavic Mini flight controller is closed; this workbench is planning/readiness only and does not issue virtual-stick, LoRa, DJI SDK, dispatch, or external notification commands.
architecture.safe_control_path: Any future live flight path must stay behind separate operator authorization, FAA/TFR/LAANC checks, VLOS/BVLOS constraints, and hardware bench validation.

assets.label: Ground Station Pi 4 + Starlink
assets.summary: Fixed property-side ground station concept with LoRa serial manager, weather sensor inputs, dashboard, logs, and Starlink/VPN backhaul.

readiness.serial: RYLR998 on UART or USB serial must be detected
readiness.persistence: service manager required for unattended runs

assets.label: Mavic Mini + Pi Zero 2 W companion
assets.summary: Phase 0 airframe concept with Pi Zero 2 W, RYLR998 LoRa bridge, lightweight mount, and no direct mission upload.

readiness.flight_control: DJI MSDK v4 virtual-stick only, not exposed by this workbench
readiness.bench_test: LoRa ping and telemetry loop required before flight

properties.label: Mavic Mini / Pi Bench Node
properties.summary: Mock GeoJSON readiness point for the Mavic Mini plus Raspberry Pi companion concept. Read-only bench state only; no flight, command, or dispatch authority is exposed.

readiness.operator_boundary: copy/read only, no tasking or command controls

assets.label: 915 MHz LoRa C2 / telemetry link
assets.summary: RYLR998 point-to-point command/telemetry concept using JSON-over-LoRa for observability and low-rate resilience.

readiness.part15: must remain within applicable power limits
readiness.rate: critical telemetry only under degraded RSSI

assets.label: Repurposed Dish directional LoRa antenna
assets.summary: Static 915 MHz dish-feed concept for primary corridor coverage; motorized tracking is intentionally out of v1 scope.

readiness.gain_estimate: Kimi research estimated roughly 16 dBi, requires RF validation

weather_gates.label: Wind speed
weather_gates.threshold: Normal ops below 8.0 m/s; hard review near Mavic Mini rating around 10.7 m/s.
weather_gates.summary: Ground-station anemometer should be treated as a go/no-go input, not a decorative metric.

weather_gates.label: Rain detection
weather_gates.threshold: Any detected rain blocks Phase 0 Mavic Mini operations.
weather_gates.summary: Rain sensor state should render as a blocking preflight gate once live hardware is connected.

weather_gates.label: Humidity / fog risk
weather_gates.threshold: Humidity above 90 percent requires lens and visibility review.
weather_gates.summary: BME280 humidity belongs in the readiness rail because fog and condensation degrade evidence quality.

weather_gates.label: Pressure trend
weather_gates.threshold: Rapidly falling pressure triggers weather-front caution.
weather_gates.summary: Barometric trend is useful context for flight timing and altitude baseline review.
